body:
Quick pass (coordinator, read only, no build) on head `8977cd5f0`: the PR is a sub-PR of `side/path-kernel` and merges cleanly with it (`6fb3d55ce`). It is sub-PR 1 of 2 for #4176: the ring planner and the row planner. The author's gate is green on this head: the quick gate against the side branch, the `laws` suite of the crate (89 passed), the motion pins `kernel_rings` and `kernel_baseline` (17 passed), and clippy on pathkernel and motion. The example catalog suites and the light lane ran on the head before the merge of the side branch. The body starts with `Side branch: side/path-kernel` and has `Refs #4176`. The PR is flagged ready. It waits for the independent review.

Notes for the reviewer:
- The trial merge and the gate base are `origin/side/path-kernel`.
- The safety floor applies: the guide curves decide where the tool cuts. No old planner calls the new code; with the default switch the output is identical.
- Check the marks: a stretch that would be cut at full width is named (`MarkKind::FullWidth`), and a mark stays with its curve after the canonical sort.
- Check the coverage rule: clean-up rings, and "incomplete" with named gaps when more than 0.1 mm2 stays uncut. The maintainer has an open question on "incomplete" for rows without a closing ring.
- The differences from the old rings are pinned in `crates/motion/tests/pass_start_levels/kernel_rings.rs`, each with its reason.

Label: needs-rework - one requested change before merge (the first_offset > tool-radius strip, see the review). PR is MERGEABLE (base 6fb3d55ce, trial merge clean); no conflict verdict. One finding is enough to gate the merge; the light lane is noted as not run locally.

Review fixes for the review of head 8977cd5f0. The new head is 74766eaa5. It waits for a fresh review.

The finding classes and the rules:
- Finding 1 (class: a guard that measures an area derived from the parameters that it must check). Commit f54a11059. Rule: one guard (`cover::judge`) for both planners. It reads the region's own centre area and the curves of the finished set. No planner gives it an area.
  - A clearing ring choice with a first offset above the tool radius is refused with `WALL_STRIP_UNCUT`.
  - A ring count names the uncut area in a note.
  - Pins: the review case (disc, tool radius 3, first offset 5, step 2), and property grids for rings (both references, disc and island pocket) and for rows. Each grid checks that done means 0.1 mm2 or less uncut, with its own measure.
  - A search of the planners found no other guard area that comes from the parameters.
- Finding 2 (class: a record that is dropped without a note). Commit 74766eaa5. Rule: nothing that a planner makes is dropped without a note. The note of a refused curve names its marks that are not kept. Unit pin: `a_refused_curve_names_its_marks_in_its_note`.
- Finding 3 (the closing ring round an island, not pinned). Commit 74766eaa5. Rule: each loop of the area gets a closing ring. Pin: `the_closing_ring_of_rows_runs_round_each_island_too`.
- Finding 4 (a full-width mark on an open ring, not pinned). Commit 74766eaa5. Pin: `a_full_width_stretch_on_an_open_ring_round_a_part_is_named`.

Gates on 74766eaa5 (base `origin/side/path-kernel`):
- quick gate: green.
- pathkernel `laws`: 98 passed.
- motion `kernel_rings` and `kernel_baseline`: 17 passed.
- `example_catalog*`: green.
- light lane: 7 of 7 green.
- clippy on pathkernel and motion: clean.

Refresh of this PR after PR #4193 (K5) merged into `side/path-kernel`. Writer record: https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/issues/4176#issuecomment-7200355232.

New head: `e872c5699d44c93878968fa386fd6c998fcb9221`. It is a merge of `side/path-kernel` at `cb93488c02df14769d2832f350c8305133474d71` into `74766eaa5`. There is no rebase and no force-push.

Conflicted file:
- `crates/pathkernel/tests/laws.rs`, only the `Gate map:` line of the module doc. Each side added module names. The resolution keeps both sides: the `guide::rings`, `guide::rows`, `guide::cover`, `guide::mark` and `guide::all` names of this PR, and the `entry::*` names of K5. It also removes one duplicate `guide::cover` entry of this PR. The module list merged with no conflict.

`crates/pathkernel/src/lib.rs` merged with no conflict. No logic of K5 or of this PR changed in the merge. The merge needed no test change: the K2 tests compile with the merged K5 helpers.

Class: DELTA (one hand-resolved hunk, in a doc comment line).

Checks on the final head:
- `cargo check --tests`, one package at a time: `camcraft-pathkernel`, `camcraft-geometry`, `camcraft-motion`: clean.
- The whole pathkernel `laws` suite: 114 passed.
- Motion `kernel_rings` and `kernel_baseline` pins: 17 passed.
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base origin/side/path-kernel`: green. The first run stopped on E0463 (stale units). After `cargo clean -p` of our crates and `CAMCRAFT_NO_SCCACHE=1`, the run was green.
- Clippy on pathkernel and motion with `-D warnings`: clean.
- The catalog suites and the light lane were not run again: the merge adds no toolpath or post change of this PR.

Label: merge-ready - the review of head e872c5699d44 is clean (quick gate green locally, pathkernel laws 114 passed, motion pass_start_levels 39 passed, clippy clean, trial merge clean with side/path-kernel at cb93488c0) and the PR merges cleanly with its base. The light lane is not run locally and is noted on the review; it is covered by a cut-gate rerun.
